question: When it is best to invest in real estate in terms of interest rate environment, stock performance and unemployment context?
query: WITH real_estate_signals AS (     SELECT         date,         real_estate_index,         interest_rate,         unemployment_rate,         stock_index,         open_price,         close_price,         (close_price - open_price) / NULLIF(open_price, 0) AS stock_return     FROM finance_economics_dataset ) SELECT     date,     real_estate_index,     interest_rate,     unemployment_rate,     stock_index,     open_price,     close_price,     stock_return FROM real_estate_signals WHERE     interest_rate   < (SELECT percentile_cont(0.33) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY interest_rate)   FROM finance_economics_dataset)   -- low
